summary: First-finish smoke test of AgroBrasil Export CRM. Backend endpoints (products, leads, trade-data, templates, tasks, dashboard/stats, interactions, add-to-crm, task toggle/delete, patch stage) all return 200 with valid JSON, no ObjectId leaks. Frontend loads correctly with all 6 pages: Dashboard KPIs render, PT/EN language toggle switches labels (Painel<->Dashboard, Catalogo<->Catalog), Catalog shows 8 seed products with working category filter (acai=2) and offer-generation dialog, Pipeline has 6 kanban columns and successfully creates a lead (3->4), Trade Intel lists 12 records with add-to-CRM buttons, Templates page shows 4 copy buttons (filtered by current lang), Tasks create+toggle works and delete button renders.
passed: GET /api/dashboard/stats returns total_leads, pipeline_value, by_stage, by_industry
POST /api/leads creates lead and it appears in Kanban
Dashboard loads with 4 KPI cards + stage/industry breakdown
Language toggle PT<->EN swaps navigation labels (Painel/Dashboard, Catalogo/Catalog)
Catalog: 8 products, filter-acai narrows to 2, generate-offer opens dialog
Pipeline: 6 kanban-column-* elements, new-lead-button opens dialog, save-lead-button creates lead visible in board
Templates: 4 copy-tpl-* buttons rendered (PT language active)
Tasks: title input + add-task-button creates task, toggle- moves to Concluidas section

failed.issue: Review request specifies data-testids kpi-active-leads, kpi-pipeline-value, kpi-samples, kpi-conversion but code exposes kpi-total-leads, kpi-won, kpi-lost, kpi-samples. Visible KPI cards on UI correctly display Leads Ativos / Valor em Pipeline / Amostras Enviadas / Taxa de Conversao, so it is a testid vs UI mismatch.
